highlights.headline: Formula 1: Rwanda to bring sport back to Africa
highlights.summary: The last time Formula 1 hosted a race in Africa was way back in 1993. But a new track in Rwanda is set to host a Grand Prix in "the early 2030s," continuing the country’s investment in international sport.

items.description: The Met Office has issued a yellow warning for wind in north-west Scotland on Wednesday with 70mph gusts possible, as Ben Rich explains.

items.title: Red squirrel project opens £250k community grant
items.description: Groups from around northern England and southern Scotland can bid for funding to help the creatures.

items.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines

items.title: Ukraine allies in Poland after Starlink sabotage, Trump diesel deal
items.description: Germany's Johann Wadephul said hybrid plots like the Starlink fire showed Europe was "in Russia's crosshairs." The UK's Ed Miliband said Trump's Russian diesel deal led to a "very difficult few days" diplomatically.

items.title: Germany's China calculation shifts as import pressures eclipse export benefits
items.description: Germany has long resisted tougher action against China, fearing retaliation. But rising pressure on key industries has pushed Berlin to seek stronger EU trade-defense powers to protect its industrial base.

items.title: Hungary's parliament votes to reverse anti-LGBTQ legislation from Orban era
items.description: Hungary's parliament passed a bill amending the 2021 "child protection law." The move is considered the first significant reversal of Orban's curbs targeting the LGBTQ+ community.
